title: UPDATE-SCRIPT-ALL-DEPENDENCIES
prompt: Create an update script that updates all dependencies from the complete monorepo. All package.json (npm), pyproject.toml (uv), Cargo.toml (cargo), go.mod (go), .csproj (c#) should be updated and not just the lock files. There should be a mechanism to make sure to prevent individual dependencies from being updated. E.g. Semio.Grasshopper should not update Grasshopper, System.Drawing.Common, System.Resources.Extensions. All local packages such as semio/js should not remove the star from the dependency of other packages when running npm upgrade -S
